tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search 90,000+ live US government surplus auction listings from 27 official sources. Supports keyword, category, state, ZIP-radius, and price filters.

query.description: Keyword search, e.g. 'forklift'. Model numbers match across spellings (f150, F-150, F 150) and common brand short forms are included (CAT, JD, Chevy, VW, IH).

zip.description: Center a radius search on this ZIP

sort.description: Default: relevance (best match) when a query is given, otherwise ending_soon

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Fetch a single listing by its BidProwl id or slug.

tools.name: sold_comps
tools.description: Sold-price stats from 250,000+ closed government auctions, nearly all from the last 12 months. Category+state aggregates, or exact percentile comps for a live listing via listing_id.

listing_id.description: Pro: exact comps for this live listing

tools.name: flip_score
tools.description: BidProwl's deal score for a live listing, with its condition-adjusted tier.

tools.name: get_api_usage
tools.description: This API key's plan, monthly call limit, calls used, calls remaining and when the quota resets (first of next month, UTC). Free to call: it does not count against the quota.

tools.name: sold_comps_batch
tools.description: Up to 25 sold_comps lookups in one call (100 on Pro+), each costing one API call. Each query is a listing id, a tracked item slug ("forklift"), a category ("vehicles"), or text naming a tracked item ("2015 Ford F150"). Item-level and per-listing answers need Pro or Pro+; categories work on every plan. Amounts are in cents.

state.description: Default 2-letter state for item and category queries

tools.name: get_sold_history
tools.description: The actual sold lots behind a comps number, newest close first: title, final price (cents), close date, state, source, BidProwl link. Pass one of category, item (tracked item slug) or q (free text, matched like a listing title), plus optional state. Paginate with cursor.

item.description: Pro: tracked item slug, e.g. forklift

q.description: Pro: free text, e.g. 2015 ford f150
